say.t: Kuro has already laid the agreement's last version and this one side by side. Clauses 6 and 11 are marked in different colours.
You read from the top. At clause 6, and at clause 11, you stop. The two fight.
Black on white, lying side by side.

kuro: Clause 6 and clause 11 contradict each other. Mark them for me.

say.t: It merged a version. You open it, scroll to clause 6, scroll to clause 11.

kuro: Merged. Clause 11 now yields to clause 6.

say.t: You clicked Approve. The merged version went into the folder, neatly named.

left: 2. Party A pays the previous month's service fee by the 10th of each month.
3. Party B submits a monthly service report; Party A confirms within five working days.
4. For late payment, Party A pays a penalty of 0.1% of the amount due per day.
5. Intellectual property in Party B's deliverables belongs to Party A.
6. Party B may suspend service when Party A is more than thirty days late.
7. Both parties keep this agreement confidential.
8. Early termination requires thirty days' written notice.
9. This agreement is governed by the law of the People's Republic of China.
10. Disputes go to the court where Party A is located.
11. Party B shall not suspend service under any circumstances.
12. Two copies, one for each party.
